verdict.rationale: Titan Security Key is a hardware FIDO authenticator. Its credentials live on the physical key, and it offers no cloud data-storage service of its own, so choosing a storage region or residency is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any data-hosting or residency capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
